description: Native EGL/OpenGL bootstrap and process lifecycle. Mesa owns GL/EGL semantics; R4OS owns presentation and resources.

functions.name: open

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Borrowed resolver address, written only on success.

operation.ownership: Process-owned runtime. Keep this R4L generation loaded until all GL/EGL calls, objects and thread cleanup have finished.

functions.description: Bind the actual application startup context and immutable kernel tables. Requires R4SYS23 and R4DRAW/R4DEV imports; Zink additionally requires the application import R4VK:VULKAN_V1:1. No EGL context or device is created. The selected profile is immutable; repeated matching opens are idempotent until finish begins.

functions.name: release_thread

operation.ownership: Process-owned runtime. Keep this R4L generation loaded until all GL/EGL calls, objects and thread cleanup have finished.

functions.description: After the thread stops using GL/EGL, run its language TLS destructors, EGL unbinding and raw TLS retirement. Call before an application-created thread returns. Library-created C11 workers do this automatically.

functions.name: finish

parameters.name: timeout_ns
parameters.description: Window-lease polling budget; clamped to five seconds. Zero skips lease waiting. Worker joins and finalizers may still block.

operation.ownership: Process-owned runtime. Keep this R4L generation loaded until all GL/EGL calls, objects and thread cleanup have finished.

functions.description: After joining application GL threads, releasing their TLS, destroying all GL/EGL objects and terminating displays, close worker admission, drain/join window retirement, run process finalizers and close native streams/options. Busy retains ownership for retry; no API reentry except finish/release_thread once called. Closed is idempotent; reopening requires a new process.

interfaces.description: Process binding for native EGL profiles. This interface version is independent of EGL/GL versions.

types.name: R4GlRuntime

fields.name: application
fields.description: Address of the actual R4XStartContext. Its immutable platform/import tables must follow the application lifetime.

fields.name: profile
fields.description: 0 selects CPU softpipe. 1 selects the initial Zink/R4VK pbuffer profile and requires the optional R4VK import. No implicit fallback or hardware claim: eglInitialize validates the actual device. Other values are rejected.

types.description: Caller startup descriptor. R4GL retains its own process snapshot, not the descriptor or a stack Bundle.

types.name: R4GlLoader

fields.name: get_proc_address
fields.description: PFNEGLGETPROCADDRESSPROC-compatible resolver for EGL and GL symbols, using the ordinary x86_64 C ABI. Null on unavailable symbol or after finish begins.

types.description: Resolve standard API commands; use eglQueryString/glGetString and context creation for supported versions/extensions. A resolved symbol alone does not admit a feature.

errors.description: Invalid/unavailable startup or unbound process. Open leaves output unchanged.
Cleanup is incomplete or concurrent; retain the R4L and retry after users stop.
Cleanup completed with a native stream flush/close error. The runtime is closed.

ownership_rules.name: threads
ownership_rules.text: Mutable Mesa state belongs to the calling process and exact thread generation. EGL context currentness and sharing follow EGL rules. Application-created threads explicitly release_thread before returning; callers serialize open/finish and quiesce GL/EGL before finish.

ownership_rules.name: presentation
ownership_rules.text: EGL_DEFAULT_DISPLAY uses the selected native profile. Softpipe window handles encode the creating application WINSVC window ID. Zink currently admits pbuffers only; native Vulkan window integration remains pending. Buffers/fences use R4DRAW and WINSVC; no host window, Linux FD or GPU handle is fabricated.

ownership_rules.name: fatal
ownership_rules.text: An unrecoverable native runtime failure terminates the calling process through R4SYS program_exit. It does not run foreign callbacks in kernel cleanup. Ordinary EGL/GL errors remain standard error returns.

ownership_rules.name: profile
ownership_rules.text: Softpipe without LLVM/JIT: EGL 1.5, up to GL 3.3 Core, output-qualified swap intervals 0..1 with firmware fallback 0. Zink: an initial GL 3.3 pbuffer path over the imported R4VK ICD, admitted only after its actual Vulkan features/limits pass. Native Zink windows and positive rendering qualification remain roadmap work. No-device is EGL_NOT_INITIALIZED and permits another initialize attempt; profiles never switch implicitly.
